analysis_status: post hoc user-requested cross-pitcher reanalysis; original same-pitcher benchmark remains frozen
exposure_definition: Prior delivered pitches of the same pitch type to the same hitter in the same game, regardless of pitcher. Current pitch excluded; takes included before selecting tracked swings.
strict_transfer_definition: Restrict to the first pitch of that type from the current pitcher; any positive same-type exposure is necessarily from other pitchers.

optimization_diagnostics.method: median-SE scaling; analytically profiled means; analytic-gradient multistart L-BFGS-B
optimization_diagnostics.best_message: CONVERGENCE: RELATIVE REDUCTION OF F <= FACTR*EPSMCH

rho_likelihood_profile.support_endpoint_method: linear interpolation between fixed-rho grid points; outermost support if disconnected
rho_likelihood_profile.scope: Fixed-rho profile diagnostic; usual chi-square confidence calibration is not assumed near zero latent variance.

pooled_same_type.rho_interpretation: No configured weak-identification flag; inference remains conditional on the measurement-error model.
pooled_same_type.bootstrap_interval_scope: Descriptive player-bootstrap quantiles; not guaranteed calibrated near zero latent variance or correlation boundaries.
pooled_same_type.scope: descriptive latent-normal correlation; independent known period SEs; weak heterogeneity may make rho unidentified

first_type_from_pitcher.rho_interpretation: Weakly identified: numerical rho and bootstrap quantiles must not be treated as a reliable persistence estimate.

pooled_same_type.definition: Within-player centered 2026 conditional residual MSE: 2025 player slopes versus 2025 population slope.
pooled_same_type.scope: Tests slope transport on held-out 2026 swings, not prospective raw-swing prediction.

first_type_from_pitcher.definition: Within-player centered 2026 conditional residual MSE: 2025 player slopes versus 2025 population slope.
first_type_from_pitcher.scope: Tests slope transport on held-out 2026 swings, not prospective raw-swing prediction.

limitations: Within-game history resets each game and does not estimate season-long retention.
Pitcher changes and pitch selection are observational; the exposure association is not a causal learning rate.
The strict transfer subset may be selected by pitcher usage and game state.
Nuisance predictions were frozen before this reanalysis but the cross-pitcher hypothesis was chosen after inspecting the original 2026 results.
